items.description: A grant through which a Corporation pays network transaction fees on behalf of a grantee account (IDX-DE-QRY-5).

id.description: Indexer-assigned per-row id, used as the pagination cursor. The VPR FeeGrant has no on-chain id.

msg_types.description: Message types the fee allowance applies to. Empty means the allowance carries no message filter and covers every type.

remaining_spend.description: Present when spend_limit is set. Sourced from the underlying x/feegrant allowance's running balance; zero once the allowance is exhausted.

expiration.description: For periodic grants this is the allowance's current period_reset, the end of the current auto-renewing cycle.

period.description: Reset period for spend_limit, as a duration (e.g. "86400s").

items.title: FeeGrant
